title: Precision Agriculture Analytics
thesis: Snowflake delivers precision agriculture at plantation scale — IoT soil/weather data feeds Dynamic Tables, ML.FORECAST projects FFB yield by block, and Cortex AI generates targeted fertilizer and harvest recommendations

talking_points: Eight hundred blocks across 45,000 hectares in North Sumatra and Central Kalimantan.
Average yield 22.4 tonnes FFB/ha — 15% below estate potential of 26.3 tonnes.
ML.FORECAST projects Rp 89 billion additional revenue if yield gap is closed.
show: Point at 22.4t/ha yield KPI vs 26.3t potential
Highlight blocks in red below 70% potential
tabs.call_out: 15% yield gap — Rp 89B revenue opportunity if closed

transition.line: Let's see which blocks are underperforming and why.

talking_points: Block K-12 in Central Kalimantan: 16.8t/ha vs 24.1t potential — potassium deficiency detected.
IoT sensors show soil K at 0.12 cmol/kg — below 0.25 critical threshold.
Fertilizer ROI analysis shows 3.2x return on potassium application in similar blocks.
show: Show soil nutrient chart with threshold lines
tabs.call_out: Block K-12: 30% below potential — potassium deficiency confirmed by IoT

transition.line: The data is clear. Let's see what ML predicts for the estate.

talking_points: ML.FORECAST projects FFB yield for each of 800 blocks — 90-day forward view.
23 blocks predicted to decline further without intervention.
Weather-adjusted forecast accounts for El Nino impact on Q1 production.
show: Point at 23 declining blocks in table
tabs.call_out: ML predicts 23 blocks declining — proactive intervention signal

transition.line: Now let the VP ask about priorities.

talking_points: Agus asks: 'Which blocks are underperforming their yield potential?'
Cortex Analyst queries yield data — returns 120 blocks below 80% potential.
Follow-up: 'Generate fertilizer recommendations for the top 10 priority blocks' — AI produces actionable plan.
show: Switch to advisory mode for recommendations
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: yield analytics + agronomist advisory

transition.line: Every capability — native Snowflake SQL, native ML.

talking_points: Six Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services in the dual-build architecture.
IoT Core replaced by Snowpipe Streaming; Timestream by Dynamic Tables; SageMaker by ML.FORECAST.
Indonesia's palm oil estates cover 16.4 million hectares. This manages 45,000 ha precision agriculture.
tabs.call_out: One platform, native IoT ingestion, native ML for yield prediction

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for precision agriculture.
